args.sql:
WITH ModelSeriesStats AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS number_of_robots,
        AVG(op.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time,
        AVG(op.progcyclecount) AS avg_programs_per_robot,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'most_efficient_program', (
                SELECT op2.currprogval 
                FROM operation op2 
                WHERE op2.operbotdetref = rd.botdetreg 
                ORDER BY op2.progcyclecount DESC 
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            'avg_OCE', (
                SELECT AVG(oce) 
                FROM (
                    SELECT UNNEST(ps.safety_metrics->'Operation Cycle Efficiency (OCE)') AS oce
                    FROM performance_and_safety ps
                    WHERE ps.effectivenessrobot = rd.botdetreg
                ) AS oce_values
            )
        ) AS program_stats,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ps.effectivenessindexval < (SELECT AVG(effectivenessindexval) FROM performance_and_safety) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS underperforming_robots
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    GROUP BY 
        rd.modelseriesval
),
RankedModelSeries AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_cycle_time ASC) AS cycle_activity_rank
    FROM 
        ModelSeriesStats
)
SELECT 
    model_series,
    number_of_robots,
    avg_cycle_time,
    avg_programs_per_robot,
    program_stats,
    underperforming_robots
FROM 
    RankedModelSeries
WHERE 
    cycle_activity_rank = 1;
